title: Test the tab hover card's Waiting state and the termal_list_sessions status precedence for Approval, Stopping and Error
outcome: buildSessionTooltipRows has unit cases for an idle session with a wait (State: Waiting plus a "Waiting for" row) and an active session with a wait (State: Active, row kept). The termal_list_sessions status test covers Approval, Stopping and Error keeping precedence over waiting.
acceptance: Test the tab hover card's Waiting state and the termal_list_sessions status precedence for Approval, Stopping and Error is done
